charts.title: K2-233 b: orbits around K2-233
charts.description: The orbits of K2-233's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-233 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lillo-Box et al. 2020 (2020A&A...640A..48L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LILLO_BOX_ET_AL__2020): P 2.4675 d

charts.title: K2-233 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-233 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 428820090, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 82 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 196 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 82 min early; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 65 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
